messages.subject: Neck warmer issue
messages.text:
Hello,

 

 I received my neck warmer today,

 order# L44667. The neck warmer is unevenly sewn at the back and is tearing at the seam. I also find it is very tight and difficult to get on. Is that normal? 

 So how do you wish to proceed? Replace the neck warmer? Return it? If so can you send me a label? Disappointed to say the least. Is it normal to have the label on the outside of the product? Please see the attached pictures. 

 Sincerely, 

 Dianne Devison 
 

 

 
 Sent
 from my iPhone

messages.subject: Insoles
messages.text:
Good morning,

Just wondering with the insoles, do you put the shiny part facing up or down in the boot. 

Thank you,

Dianne 

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Insoles
messages.text:
Good morning Dianne,
 

 Thank you for your question 😊
 

 The shiny (reflective) side should face up , meaning your foot goes directly on the reflective surface.
 

 This membrane is designed to reflect your body heat back toward your foot, helping to retain warmth inside the boot.
 If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out — we’re happy to help!
 

 Warm regards,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
